meta.name: firecrawl
meta.description: Search, scrape, and interact with the web via the Firecrawl CLI. Use this skill whenever the user wants to search the web, find articles, research a topic, look something up online, scrape a webpage, grab content from a URL, get data from a website, crawl documentation, download a site, or interact with pages that need clicks or logins. Also use when they say "fetch this page", "pull the content from", "get the page at https://", or reference external websites. This provides real-time web search with full page content and interact capabilities — beyond what Claude can do natively with built-in tools. Do NOT trigger for local file operations, git commands, deployments, or code editing tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索、抓取并交互网页内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从网页获取结构化数据或进行实时搜索。
copy.tagline_en: Search, scrape, and interact with web content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract structured data from websites or perform real-time web searches.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 Firecrawl CLI 搜索网页、抓取页面内容、爬取整个网站、与需要点击或登录的页面交互，并监控网页变化。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索、查找文章、研究主题、抓取网页内容、爬取文档、下载网站，或说“获取这个页面”、“拉取内容”等时触发。

say.text: 搜索“人工智能最新进展”并抓取结果。
say.note: Claude 会执行搜索并返回页面内容。
Claude 会提取该页面的 markdown 内容。

say.text: 监控 https://example.com/pricing 的价格变化。
say.note: Claude 会设置一个监控，定期检查并通知变化。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can use the Firecrawl CLI to search the web, scrape page content, crawl entire sites, interact with pages that need clicks or logins, and monitor web pages for changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search, find articles, research a topic, scrape a webpage, crawl documentation, download a site, or say "fetch this page", "pull the content from", etc.

say_en.text: Search for 'latest AI advancements' and scrape results.
say_en.note: Claude will search and return page content.
Claude will extract the page's markdown.
Claude will set up a monitor to check periodically.
